tasks.description:

tasks.subject: Task 7: Wire tabs/sorting/podium/rows/backdrop into LeaderboardView
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Weekly/Season/School tabs over the same fetched data, with podium, rows, contest banner, past winners, and orchard-sky backdrop.

**Files:**
- Modify: app/components/LeaderboardView.tsx

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Segmented tabs Weekly(default)/Season/School; local state; no refetch on switch
- Weekly sort by pulpDelta (metric delta); Season by totalPulp (metric total); School existing order
- Top3 -> Podium; ranks 4+ -> LeaderboardRow keeping setSelectedPlayer
- Weekly shows ContestBanner (CONTEST_PRIZE_SAP=500, daysLeftInWeek()) + PastWinnersStrip placeholder from top entry
- Replace BoardDoodles watermark with orchard-sky gradient (themePalette), pointer-events-none, behind content
- School picker flow unchanged + reachable
- resolvedRank/your-row highlight intact
- npm run build + lint pass

**Verify:** npm run build && npm run lint; manual: 3 tabs, re-order without flash, podium trees, weekly banner+countdown

```json:metadata
{"files": ["app/components/LeaderboardView.tsx"], "verifyCommand": "npm run build && npm run lint", "acceptanceCriteria": ["3 tabs no refetch", "per-tab sort", "podium+rows", "weekly banner", "sky backdrop", "picker intact"]}
```
